title: Public image memory uploads via system file picker (gallery/Drive) in Media Manager

requirements.summary: Make Images editable for all visitors while keeping Hero/Videos/Song admin-only, and ensure non-admin submit only publishes image changes with English error handling.
acceptanceCriteria: When not an admin, the Media Manager still shows lock messaging for Hero/Videos/Song, but the Images tab allows Upload/Replace/Adjust/Clear/Reorder and Submit.
The Images tab no longer shows 'Administrator or image uploader access required' for non-admin users.
The submit flow in non-admin mode publishes only image-related changes (no hero/video/song actions attempted), and errors (if any) are shown in English without closing the dialog.

file_operations.description: Update permissions computation so Images are editable for all visitors (including anonymous/guest), while Hero/Videos/Song remain admin-only; keep permission state and user-facing lock logic consistent with the new behavior. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Adjust Media Manager tab visibility/behavior so non-admins can still see Hero/Videos/Song sections with lock messaging (not hidden), while Images remains fully editable; update submit flow gating so non-admin submit publishes only image-related changes (no hero/video/song calls), and ensure all lock/permission copy is accurate and in English. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Update backend error translation messaging to reflect new authorization (remove/avoid image-uploader allowlist messaging), keeping all user-facing errors in clear English and ensuring failures do not close the dialog. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Update Media Manager UI copy to clarify users can pick images from phone gallery or Google Drive via the device file picker without any Drive login inside the app.
acceptanceCriteria: Media Manager includes a short, clear English instruction near image uploading controls, e.g., indicating that the upload picker may offer 'Photos' or 'Google Drive' depending on the device.
No UI implies a Google Drive OAuth/login integration or requires connecting a Drive account inside the app.

file_operations.description: Add concise English helper text near image upload controls explaining the system file picker may show device gallery/Photos or Google Drive options depending on the device, and explicitly stating no separate Google Drive login is required in the app. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
